title: Molecular structure of titania-supported molybdena: in situ Raman and FTIR spectroscopy of distinct MoVIOx configurations dispersed on titania
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23019-23036
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00034G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Theocharis Kentri, Paraskevas Dimitropoulos, Konstantina Niavi, Eleana Kordouli, Soghomon Boghosian
In situ Raman and FTIR spectroscopies unravel the structural properties of the (MoOx)n phase dispersed on two TiO2 polymorphs (anatase and Degussa P25) at temperatures of 430–120 °C and coverages of 0.5–5 Mo per nm2 under oxidative dehydrated conditions.
